meta.requirement: Explore Wolvendom (5%+ exploration) to trigger this quest.

customTabs.label: TIP
customTabs.content:
You can click the '''Collapse''' button and the '''Best Route''' → '''Important Only''' button at the top to minimize it.
''Some quests will not have a Best Route choice, because the best choice is subjective or not yet found.''

You can also click the '''Endings''' button at the top to view all possible endings, and clicking an ending will show the options needed to reach that ending.

start.title: Unwanted Company
start.text:
''A wet hiss. A sharp pop. Then a man's voice, strained and too loud for the woods.''

Owen: ''shouting at nothing in particular'' I said shove off!

''You push through the undergrowth and find him backed against a mossy log, hatchet raised in one shaking hand. A red slime bobs at his left. A blue one pulses at his right. Neither has left yet.''

Owen: ''spotting you'' Traveller! ''without looking away from the slimes'' Tell me you brought something sharper than good intentions!

getbehindme.text:
''Owen drops low and scrambles behind the log. The Pyro Slime pops once, warningly. The Hydro Slime wobbles forward, testing the distance.''

''Two slimes. One woodcutter who has had enough of both of them.''

dialogues.speaker: 📌 Objective
dialogues.text: Defeat the Pyro and Hydro Slimes attacking Owen in Wolvendom

continues.label: Do /rpg again and click on Fight the Slimes. Defeat 1 [[Pyro Slime]] and 1 [[Hydro Slime]]

slimes_driven_off.title: Slimes Driven Off
slimes_driven_off.text:
''The slimes are gone. Owen emerges from behind the log, brushing moss from his sleeves like nothing happened.''

Owen: ''exhales'' Right. That's better.

''He sheathes his hatchet and digs a few coins from his belt pouch.''

Owen: Not much, but it's yours. You showed up when it counted. ''nods once'' Safe travels, traveller.

walked_away.title: Walked Away
walked_away.text:
''You step back into the trees. Owen catches the movement from the corner of his eye.''

Owen: Wait, hold on, I didn't mean—

''The Pyro Slime pops. The Hydro Slime surges. Owen's complaint cuts off into something less articulate.''

''You keep walking. The woods swallow the noise behind you.''
